name: Habits
description: Build lasting habits with flexible frequency, grace days, and pause support. Daily, weekday, or X-per-week goals that forgive occasional misses so you keep going.

source.query: SELECT h.id AS id, h.title AS title, NULLIF(h.why, '') AS subtitle, h.owner_id AS member_id, :today AS when_at, CASE WHEN l.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS done FROM app_habits__habits h LEFT JOIN app_habits__logs l ON l.habit_id = h.id AND l.logged_date = :today LEFT JOIN app_habits__pauses p ON p.habit_id = h.id AND p.start_date <= :today AND p.end_date >= :today WHERE h.archived_at IS NULL AND p.id IS NULL AND (h.frequency <> 'weekdays' OR CAST(strftime('%w', :today) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 5) ORDER BY h.created_at LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM app_habits__habits h LEFT JOIN app_habits__logs l ON l.habit_id = h.id AND l.logged_date = :today LEFT JOIN app_habits__pauses p ON p.habit_id = h.id AND p.start_date <= :today AND p.end_date >= :today WHERE h.archived_at IS NULL AND l.id IS NULL AND p.id IS NULL AND (h.frequency <> 'weekdays' OR CAST(strftime('%w', :today) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 5) LIMIT 1
